scene: The glowing claw machine whirs, displaying three curious bobbing pixel treasures.
picture: First-person close-up inside the brightly lit claw machine glass. A three-pronged metal claw dangles up high above a prize bed. On the left is a vintage wind-up tin robot, in the centre rests a shimmering golden prize capsule, and on the right sits a plump sleeping calico plush cat.
shown: a shiny tin robot figurine wobbling on the left behind the glass
a mysterious golden egg sitting stationary in the centre prize pit
a sleeping calico plush wedged on the right beneath the metal claw
